title: "8D" City—Chongqing
synopsis: Built on mountains, Chongqing has been dubbed an "8D" city due to its maze-like, multi-level streets.

fullText.simplified:
“8D”城市——重庆

    中国是一个多山的国家，所以有很多山城。说到最有名的山城，那一定是重庆。
    重庆在中国西南部，这里的山水很漂亮。但是，住在山上却不容易，因为人们很难搬走山上的大石头。所以，重庆人选择不搬走石头，而是在山上建房子。这样，重庆就成了一个“8D”城市。比如说，你的一楼，可能是邻居的十六楼。因为你住在山上，邻居住在山下。
    除了山水漂亮，重庆的火锅也很有名。重庆潮湿多雨，所以重庆人很爱吃辣，特别是火锅。重庆火锅又红又辣，不但好吃，而且很有特色。最早的火锅是河边的工人发明的。他们想办法把便宜的菜做得好吃，慢慢地就有了火锅。
    这就是“8D”城市重庆。漂亮的山水给重庆人带来了生活上的难题，但重庆人用热情和努力把这里变得更漂亮了。
fullText.traditional:
“8D”城市——重慶

    中國是一個多山的國家，所以有很多山城。說到最有名的山城，那一定是重慶。
    重慶在中國西南部，這裡的山水很漂亮。但是，住在山上卻不容易，因為人們很難搬走山上的大石頭。所以，重慶人選擇不搬走石頭，而是在山上建房子。這樣，重慶就成了一個“8D”城市。比如說，你的一樓，可能是鄰居的十六樓。因為你住在山上，鄰居住在山下。
    除了山水漂亮，重慶的火鍋也很有名。重慶潮濕多雨，所以重慶人很愛吃辣，特別是火鍋。重慶火鍋又紅又辣，不但好吃，而且很有特色。最早的火鍋是河邊的工人發明的。他們想辦法把便宜的菜做得好吃，慢慢地就有了火鍋。
    這就是“8D”城市重慶。漂亮的山水給重慶人帶來了生活上的難題，但重慶人用熱情和努力把這裡變得更漂亮了。

sentences.simplified: 中国是一个多山的国家，所以有很多山城。
sentences.traditional: 中國是一個多山的國家，所以有很多山城。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó shì yí ge duō shān de guó jiā suǒ yǐ yǒu hěn duō shān chéng
sentences.english: China is a country with many mountains, so there are many mountain cities.

sentences.simplified: 说到最有名的山城，那一定是重庆。
sentences.traditional: 說到最有名的山城，那一定是重慶。
sentences.pinyin: shuō dào zuì yǒu míng de shān chéng nà yí dìng shì chóng qìng
sentences.english: When it comes to the most famous mountain city, it must be Chongqing.

sentences.simplified: 重庆在中国西南部，这里的山水很漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 重慶在中國西南部，這裡的山水很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: chóng qìng zài zhōng guó xī nán bù zhè lǐ de shān shuǐ hěn piào liang
sentences.english: Chongqing is located in southwestern China, and the landscape here is very beautiful.

sentences.simplified: 但是，住在山上却不容易，因为人们很难搬走山上的大石头。
sentences.traditional: 但是，住在山上卻不容易，因為人們很難搬走山上的大石頭。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhù zài shān shang què bù róng yì yīn wèi rén men hěn nán bān zǒu shān shang de dà shí tou
sentences.english: However, living on a mountain is not easy because it is very difficult to move the large rocks there.

sentences.simplified: 所以，重庆人选择不搬走石头，而是在山上建房子。
sentences.traditional: 所以，重慶人選擇不搬走石頭，而是在山上建房子。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ chóng qìng rén xuǎn zé bù bān zǒu shí tou ér shì zài shān shang jiàn fáng zi
sentences.english: Therefore, the people of Chongqing chose not to move the rocks but to build houses on the mountains.

sentences.simplified: 这样，重庆就成了一个“8D”城市。比如说，你的一楼，可能是邻居的十六楼。
sentences.traditional: 這樣，重慶就成了一個“8D”城市。比如說，你的一樓，可能是鄰居的十六樓。

sentences.english: In this way, Chongqing has become an “8D” city. For example, your first floor might be your neighbor’s sixteenth floor.

sentences.simplified: 因为你住在山上，邻居住在山下。
sentences.traditional: 因為你住在山上，鄰居住在山下。

sentences.english: Because you live on the top of the mountain, and your neighbor lives at the bottom of the mountain.

sentences.traditional: 除了山水漂亮，重慶的火鍋也很有名。

sentences.english: Other than the beautiful landscapes, Chongqing’s hot pot is also very famous.

sentences.simplified: 重庆潮湿多雨，所以重庆人很爱吃辣，特别是火锅。
sentences.traditional: 重慶潮濕多雨，所以重慶人很愛吃辣，特別是火鍋。

sentences.english: Chongqing is humid and rainy, so people there love to eat spicy food, especially hot pot.

sentences.simplified: 重庆火锅又红又辣，不但好吃，而且很有特色。
sentences.traditional: 重慶火鍋又紅又辣，不但好吃，而且很有特色。
sentences.pinyin: chóng qìng huǒ guō yòu hóng yòu là bú dàn hǎo chī ér qiě hěn yǒu tè sè
sentences.english: Chongqing hot pot is red and spicy. It is not only delicious but also very distinctive.

sentences.simplified: 最早的火锅是河边的工人发明的。
sentences.traditional: 最早的火鍋是河邊的工人發明的。
sentences.pinyin: zuì zǎo de huǒ guō shì hé biān de gōng rén fā míng de
sentences.english: The earliest hot pot was invented by workers by the river.

sentences.traditional: 他們想辦法把便宜的菜做得好吃，慢慢地就有了火鍋。

sentences.english: This is the “8D” city of Chongqing.

sentences.simplified: 但重庆人用热情和努力把这里变得更漂亮了。
sentences.traditional: 但重慶人用熱情和努力把這裡變得更漂亮了。

sentence_translations: China is a country with many mountains, so there are many mountain cities.
When it comes to the most famous mountain city, it must be Chongqing.
Chongqing is located in southwestern China, and the landscape here is very beautiful.
However, living on a mountain is not easy because it is very difficult to move the large rocks there.
Therefore, the people of Chongqing chose not to move the rocks but to build houses on the mountains.
In this way, Chongqing has become an “8D” city. For example, your first floor might be your neighbor’s sixteenth floor.
Because you live on the top of the mountain, and your neighbor lives at the bottom of the mountain.
Other than the beautiful landscapes, Chongqing’s hot pot is also very famous.
Chongqing is humid and rainy, so people there love to eat spicy food, especially hot pot.
Chongqing hot pot is red and spicy. It is not only delicious but also very distinctive.
The earliest hot pot was invented by workers by the river.
They were thinking of ways to make inexpensive ingredients taste good, and gradually, hot pot came into being.
This is the “8D” city of Chongqing.
The beautiful landscapes have brought challenges to the lives of the people of Chongqing, ..
.. but through their warmth and hard work, the people of Chongqing have made the city even more beautiful.
